project_title: Investigating the Gut Microbiota Composition of Individuals with Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder and Association with Symptoms
project_description: Case-control fecal 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing study of 107 adolescents/young adults (ages 13-29; ADHD, subthreshold ADHD, and age-matched controls) from the Dutch NeuroIMAGE cohort, testing genus-level abundance differences between ADHD cases and controls.
notes: Adolescents/young adults (13-29y), NeuroIMAGE cohort. Nominal (uncorrected p<0.05) case-control genus-level difference; only genus with higher relative abundance in ADHD vs controls.

project_title: Gut microbiota and plasma cytokine levels in patients with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder
project_description: Case-control fecal 16S rRNA V3-V4 amplicon microbiome and plasma cytokine study of 41 children with ADHD versus 39 healthy controls, using LEfSe/LDA effect-size analysis to identify differentially abundant genera.
citation: Wang et al. 2022, Translational Psychiatry, PMID 35197458
notes: Children with ADHD vs healthy controls. LEfSe identified this genus with a higher LDA score in the ADHD group (significant increase in frequency vs controls); exact LDA score/p-value not stated in extractable text.

project_title: Impact of psychostimulants on microbiota and short-chain fatty acids alterations in children with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder
project_description: Case-control fecal 16S rRNA sequencing and targeted SCFA metabolomics study of 30 children ages 6-12 (10 unmedicated ADHD, 10 medicated ADHD, 10 healthy controls), using ANCOM-BC differential abundance analysis.
citation: Boonchooduang et al. 2025, Scientific Reports, PMID 39856212
notes: Children ages 6-12. Comparison is unmedicated ADHD vs healthy controls (medicated ADHD group not used for this row). Abstract states significantly lower level vs controls; exact p/q-value not stated in extractable text.
